name: ~Makai de Maid~ Akuma to Tenshi to Yuusha no Himitsu no Kissaten
original_name: ~魔界でメイド~悪魔と天使と勇者の秘密の喫茶店
source:
The protagonist who Reincarnated to the Demon World became a black mascot, in order to restore his original appearance. Use the knowledge of the "different world" to transform the little devil's tavern into a maid cafe, and aim for the first maid cafe in the demon world!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1377550/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
转生到魔界的主角，为了恢复本来的面貌，变成了黑色吉祥物。利用“异世界”的知识，将小恶魔的酒馆改造成女仆咖啡馆，向魔界第一女仆咖啡馆目标迈进！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1377550/]Steam[/url]]
